Experience

Software Engineer Intern

Amazon (Amazon Web Services)
Vancouver, BC | June 2024 - August 2024
  • Developed and implemented an engine for AWS Glue to improve the deployment framework, enabling individual, conflict-free connector deployments, reducing deployment time, and improving efficiency.
  • Collaborated with engineers to optimize the deployment process, facilitating smoother integration and enhancing the overall scalability of AWS services.
  • Created design and technical documentation for intern project, including a migration plan to ensure smooth adoption across teams, improving project continuity and knowledge transfer

Data Processing Intern

Federated Insurance Company of Canada
Winnipeg, MB | May 2023 - August 2023
  • Maintained and updated the client database, ensuring accurate and complete client information for informed decision-making.
  • Implemented a data entry process that increased client data entry speeds by 50%, improving overall efficiency.
  • Managed client files with systematic labelling and organization, facilitating quick access to client information and minimizing search times.

Projects

Color Pal (AI Color Palette Generator)

GitHub * Designed and implemented a highly efficient and accurate color palette generator, leveraging the power of OpenAI’s API and using a combination of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, and Flask.

LLaMA Story

GitHub * Designed and implemented a dynamic SMS-based storytelling platform, utilizing Twilio’s API, React, and Node.js, allowing two users to collaboratively create a story. Integrated LLaMA for AI-generated visual representations of the story and enabled seamless communication between users via SMS.

Garbage Collector

GitHub * Implemented a garbage collector in C and C++ that uses a mark and sweep algorithm to provide automatic memory management, optimize resource utilization, prevent memory leaks, and enhance overall performance and stability for handling generic data.

Command Line Code Review

GitHub * Created a versatile code reviewer tool in Python, capable of analyzing files from any programming language. * Effectively identifies errors and provides insightful suggestions for improving code quality and adhering to best practices

Technical Skills

Languages: Java, Python, C, C++, R, Swift, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML/CSS.

Technologies: Git, Linux, React, NodeJS, Jupyter, Figma, Angular, Flask, REST APIs, MongoDB, AWS CDK

Leadership/Extracurricular

Student Advocate, UM Computer Science Student Association

Sept 2023 - Apr 2024

Advocated for student needs by facilitating communication with administration and implementing support initiatives.

Volunteer Tutor, CanU Canada

May 2023

Tutored 35 students, grades 5 to 12, in a 5-week website development workshop using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
